selection: For each objective and fit population, choose one LR by arithmetic mean of its five same-population inner macro-phone NLL values. Both LRs require all five folds. Exact ties choose lower LR 0.0003. No outer outcomes are consumed.
epochRule: Integer median of five best epochs at the selected LR, fixed before the full-population refit; no stopping or selection based on in-sample output.
initialization: Fresh seed7 model and AdamW optimizer; no inner or outer checkpoint warm start
hyperparameters: Reuse original frozen target-scalars head: 1037features, hidden128/phone128, dropout.1, AdamWwd.01, batch64, CPU2threads
fitPopulation: All eligible author-training target rows for all-age; exactly ages6–12 for child-only. Fixed23supported targets; ZH unsupported.
statistics: Column mean/population SD, per-phone +1/class prior and any class weights fitted only on this final fit population
weightedObjective: Original global inverse-square-root fit prevalence weights, ratio cap10, prevalence-weighted mean1; no per-row target renormalization; inference subtracts logweights before softmax. Objective correction is not empirical calibration.
export: Research checkpoint and fit statistics plus target inventory, immutable feature binding, complete inner artifact provenance and exact feature-input replay
verification: In-sample probabilities solely establish artifact replay; no training-set performance claim
limitations: Subjective five-rater scores do not identify actually produced phones
No ages2–5 or verified childSSD validation
Forced canonical occupancy windows are not true phone boundaries
A full-fit export is not an independently validated model
